meta.description: Turns paths into geometry, the step before the output: every path becomes a tube of its thickness, geometry and instances are passed on. With bake on everything becomes one geometry, for example to place a whole umbel with its flowers with an instance node.

input.description: The paths, geometry and instances, for example from a join.

resolution_circle.description: How many segments a path has around, from the setting resolution.circle. max_circle_segments lowers it.

max_circle_segments.description: The most segments around a path, lower it for small parts. 0 uses the circle resolution setting.

max_points.description: The most points along a path, longer paths are resampled to this many. 0 keeps all points.

bake.description: Bake the instances too and give everything as one geometry, so an instance node can place the whole part like a leaf. Off, the instances stay instances, which draw faster.

variants.description: Bake every stem of the input into its own geometry, with the paths and instances that grow on it, and give them as a list. Every stem draws its own random values, so an instance node can pick a different variant for every instance.
